name: manual_12e4b4
claim: The Git repository root for orchestration is orama-system, not the parent OpenClaw directory, and start.sh does not support a --sync flag.

decisions.notes: Git commands run at the OpenClaw root will fail (fatal: not a git repository). Ensure git operations target orama-system or Perpetua-Tools. Additionally, start.sh in orama-system does not accept --sync; use explicit scripts like /ecc-sync or /sync-gbrain for synchronization.
